name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown menu
description: Action menu with checkbox items, shortcuts and destructive items.
htmlExample:
<bef-dropdown-menu>
  <bef-dropdown-menu-trigger as-child>
    <bef-button variant="outline">Account <bef-more-icon></bef-more-icon></bef-button>
  </bef-dropdown-menu-trigger>
  <bef-dropdown-menu-content class="w-56" align="start">
    <bef-dropdown-menu-label>aarav@company.com</bef-dropdown-menu-label>
    <bef-dropdown-menu-item><bef-user-icon></bef-user-icon> Profile <bef-dropdown-menu-shortcut>P</bef-dropdown-menu-shortcut></bef-dropdown-menu-item>
    <bef-dropdown-menu-item><bef-credit-card-icon></bef-credit-card-icon> Billing</bef-dropdown-menu-item>
    <bef-dropdown-menu-item><bef-settings-icon></bef-settings-icon> Settings <bef-dropdown-menu-shortcut>,</bef-dropdown-menu-shortcut></bef-dropdown-menu-item>
    <bef-dropdown-menu-separator></bef-dropdown-menu-separator>
    <bef-dropdown-menu-checkbox-item checked emit="checked-change">Compact rows</bef-dropdown-menu-checkbox-item>
    <bef-dropdown-menu-separator></bef-dropdown-menu-separator>
    <bef-dropdown-menu-item destructive><bef-log-out-icon></bef-log-out-icon> Sign out</bef-dropdown-menu-item>
  </bef-dropdown-menu-content>
</bef-dropdown-menu>
